info.title: Ghat Sentinel API
info.description: Environmental intelligence for Bhopal Visarjan Ghat Watch. Observations, deterministic calculations, AI explanations, experimental forecasts and human-reviewed cases are kept distinct. Historical MPPCB samples (2023-2025) only: this API does not provide live monitoring. JWT bearer authentication with roles officer, worker, citizen, developer and demo (see docs/AUTH.md).

post.summary: Log in with email and password

get.summary: List ghats found in the imported data

get.description: Deterministic project-defined heuristic; not an official classification. Date filters apply at year granularity. cpcb_class selects the intended use (default B, outdoor bathing).

get.summary: CPCB criteria used by the comparison engine

get.description: Returns an experimental estimate only when enough comparable history exists; otherwise a historical comparison or insufficient_data. Never an observed reading. parameter defaults to 'Dissolved oxygen'; omitting ghat_id pools ghats into a historical comparison only.

post.summary: Ask a question about approved guidance

get.summary: Historical comparison and sample freshness (not live)
Verification queue (workers see only their assigned cases)

patch.description: Officers/developers may change any field. Workers may only update their own assigned cases: notes, resolution_summary and status (under_review or resolved).

post.description: format=json returns the structured Report. format=csv returns a text/csv attachment with one row per reading, its criterion comparison and ghat priority.

get.summary: Active officers and workers for the recipient picker

post.summary: Send a brief by e-mail (one message per recipient)
post.description: Per-recipient failures are reported in `results`; the request itself still returns 200. 503 CHANNEL_NOT_CONFIGURED when SMTP is not set up (unless MESSAGING_DRY_RUN).

post.summary: Send a brief by WhatsApp (Meta Cloud API)
post.description: Template mode is deliverable any time; text mode only inside Meta's 24-hour customer-service window. Per-recipient failures are reported in `results`.

get.summary: Audit log of sent messages, newest first

post.description: Officers may create worker and officer accounts; only developers may create developer accounts. Citizens self-register via /auth/register.
